description:
## CONTEXT
Workspace owner ruling 2026-07-04 (workspace ISS-822, Option A): storybloq deletes its in-tree lens fork and consumes this package end-to-end. This ticket makes that consumable: the core surface becomes stable library API and 0.3.0 is prepped. Release order: this package publishes 0.3.0 BEFORE storybloq 1.5.0 (publish itself is owner-run, not part of this ticket).

## VERIFIED STATE @ 770cfd5 (2026-07-04)
src/index.ts exports only: main (server), schema/* re-export, LensId type. NOT exported: the lens registry and prompt bodies (src/lenses/registry.ts, src/lenses/prompts/*), prompt-builder, the merger pipeline (src/merger/*: dedup, verdict, tension, blocking-policy, pipeline), activation/SURFACE_RULES. package.json name @storybloq/lenses, version 0.2.0, published public on npm, main dist/index.js, tsup build.

## SCOPE
1. Export from src/index.ts as PUBLIC API: the lens registry (lens list, getLens, activate/SURFACE_RULES), prompt construction (buildLensPrompt + shared preamble entry points), the merger pipeline entry (mergeLensOutputs or equivalent single function covering dedup + blocking policy + verdict + tensions), and blocking-policy/verdict types. Schema stays exported as today.
2. Mark the exported surface with a stability note in README (consumers: the storybloq autonomous backend); no breaking renames of existing exports.
3. Bump version to 0.3.0 in package.json (no publish in this ticket).
4. public-api.test.ts extended: every newly exported symbol is importable from the package root and typed; a consumer-shaped smoke test builds a prompt for one lens and merges two synthetic lens outputs through the pipeline entry using only root imports.

## OUT OF SCOPE
npm publish (owner-run at ship gate); any behavior change to prompts/merger (T-026/T-027/T-028 own those); MCP server/tool changes; the storybloq-side consumption (workspace ISS-823).

## ACCEPTANCE
npm test green (>= current baseline); new public-api assertions RED before the export change and GREEN after; npm pack --dry-run succeeds; version reads 0.3.0; tsup build emits the new exports in dist with types.

## PITFALLS
Do not export internal state modules (review-state, caches) - the consumer uses the library core, not the server internals. Keep .strict() schemas intact. No em dashes; no Co-Authored-By trailers; never push; commit local main only.

## VERIFICATION
From a scratch dir outside the repo: npm pack the tarball, install it into a throwaway package, import { buildLensPrompt-equivalent, merge entry, activate, getLens } from "@storybloq/lenses", run the consumer-shaped smoke against the tarball build.

## SIZING
S-M. src/index.ts, package.json, README, test/public-api.test.ts (+ possibly small barrel files). Portable enough for the lowest permitted execution tier.


## PLAN-REVIEW RULINGS ROUND 3 (2026-07-04, wave 3c, binding):

These rulings resolve EVERY round-2 plan-gate finding. The next plan implements them as written; none is open for re-litigation. All facts re-derived at HEAD 770cfd5 on 2026-07-04.

R-C1 (resolves the major architecture finding: exported registry singletons expose mutable Zod optsSchema internals, src/lenses/prompts/index.ts:57). Required design, exactly one:
- Do NOT export the internal LensDefinition singletons, any Zod optsSchema instance, or renderBody through the package root. Verified mechanism: LensDefinition.optsSchema (prompts/index.ts:63) is a live z.ZodTypeAny and each renderBody closure calls the SAME schema instance's .parse (e.g. SecurityLensOptsSchema.parse, prompts/index.ts:85), so a consumer monkey-patching a reachable instance would corrupt later renderLensBody/buildLensPrompt output process-wide. The round-2 plan's immutability smoke test that asserted this escape hatch stays mutable is REJECTED; R-C2 defines its replacement.
- Create ONE new T-033-owned module, src/lenses/public.ts, exporting:
  1. type PublicLensDefinition = Pick<LensDefinition, "id" | "version" | "defaultModel" | "maxSeverity" | "type"> (no optsSchema, no renderBody).
  2. const LENSES: Readonly<Record<LensId, PublicLensDefinition>> built ONCE at module load as per-lens projection copies of the internal registry entries, each Object.freeze()d, and the record Object.freeze()d. All five projected fields are strings, so shallow freeze per object is a full deep freeze. The internal singletons in prompts/index.ts are neither mutated nor frozen.
  3. function getLens(lensId: LensId): PublicLensDefinition returning the shared frozen projection, with the same unknown-id runtime guard style as renderLensBody (prompts/index.ts:156-168): throw Error listing valid ids.
  4. const SURFACE_RULES: Readonly<Record<LensId, SurfaceRule>> as a deep-frozen deep COPY (freeze the record, each rule object, each nested array) of the internal SURFACE_RULES (src/lenses/registry.ts:145). To reach it, apply visibility flips ONLY: add export to the existing SurfaceRule type (registry.ts:143) and the existing SURFACE_RULES const (registry.ts:145). Zero other edits to registry.ts.
- src/index.ts re-exports LENSES, getLens, SURFACE_RULES, and type PublicLensDefinition from public.ts, plus the in-scope function/type exports (activate, buildLensPrompt, renderLensBody, shared-preamble entries, runMergerPipeline, blocking-policy/verdict types). Functions and types carry no consumer-mutable state, ESM import bindings are read-only, and package.json "exports" already restricts consumers to the root entry, so nothing outside public.ts's frozen surface is reachable.
- NO parseLensOpts wrapper in T-033. buildLensPrompt already validates opts internally (renderLensBody path, one trust boundary by design per prompt-builder.ts:84 doc comment). If workspace ISS-823 needs direct opts validation it is a new ticket, not scope creep here.

R-C2 (resolves the documentation + test half of the same finding, per owner guidance). Required design, exactly one:
- The README stability note (SCOPE item 2) MUST contain a "Mutability boundary" paragraph stating: all registry objects exported from the package root are frozen projections; Zod schema instances and renderBody implementations are internal and unreachable from the public surface; mutating any exported registry object throws in strict mode and can never alter prompt construction. Mirror one-line TSDoc on LENSES, getLens, and SURFACE_RULES in public.ts.
- test/public-api.test.ts MUST add, using root imports only:
  (a) Object.isFrozen assertions on LENSES, LENSES["security"], SURFACE_RULES, SURFACE_RULES.performance, and SURFACE_RULES.performance.extensions;
  (b) boundary assertions: getLens("security") has neither an "optsSchema" nor a "renderBody" own property;
  (c) mutation-cannot-alter-output proof: capture baseline = buildLensPrompt(fixed params) for the security lens; attempt three mutations, each wrapped in expect(...).toThrow(TypeError): assign to a field of getLens("security"), replace LENSES["security"], push onto SURFACE_RULES.performance.extensions; then re-run the identical buildLensPrompt call and assert strict equality with the baseline.
- These assertions are the RED-before / GREEN-after evidence required by ACCEPTANCE.

R-C3 (resolves the minor release finding: stale package-lock.json root metadata, package-lock.json:2). Fact confirmed at HEAD: package.json reads 0.2.0 / PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0 while the lockfile top-level "version" is "0.0.0" and packages[""].license is "MIT". Required design, exactly one:
- Version prep is: edit package.json version to 0.3.0, run npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts from the repo root, then verify the lockfile top-level version AND packages[""].version both read "0.3.0" AND packages[""].license reads "PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0".
- Stage package.json and package-lock.json together with explicit paths. Never hand-edit the lockfile. Incidental normalization churn npm produces in that run is accepted IF npm test stays at baseline green; if churn touches dependency versions and anything fails, STOP and park per R-C5.

R-C4 (resolves the CONFIRMED blocking dts finding: the round-2 F2 claim and its absence-grep gate are factually false and unachievable). Facts re-verified at HEAD 770cfd5: dist/index.d.ts ALREADY contains the full 9-lens literal declare const LENSES at dist/index.d.ts:1490 (9 renderBody occurrences) with type LensId = keyof typeof LENSES at :1591 and only type LensId exported (:1593), caused solely by the type-only export at src/index.ts:3. Any design that keeps LensId = keyof typeof LENSES (mandated by R-C5) necessarily keeps a full internal literal in the rolled-up dts (rollup-dts renames it, e.g. LENSES$1). Required design, exactly one:
- The dts verification gate is PRESENCE of the narrowed exported contracts, never ABSENCE of the internal literal. After npm run build, ALL of these must succeed against dist/index.d.ts:
  grep -F "Readonly<Record<LensId, PublicLensDefinition>>" dist/index.d.ts
  grep -F "(lensId: LensId): PublicLensDefinition" dist/index.d.ts
  grep -F "Readonly<Record<LensId, SurfaceRule>>" dist/index.d.ts
  plus: the final export statement in dist/index.d.ts lists LENSES, getLens, SURFACE_RULES, activate, buildLensPrompt, and runMergerPipeline.
- Deterministic fallback (no improvisation): if a grep fails ONLY because rollup-dts suffixed an identifier (LensId$1, SurfaceRule$1, ...), re-run the same grep with the suffixed identifier; the gate passes if it matches AND the export statement aliases the symbol back to its public name. Record the substitution in the completion note.
- The internal renamed literal REMAINS in dist/index.d.ts by design. It is pre-existing at 0.2.0, it is not the public value contract, and dts size growth (about 54 KB to about 72 KB was measured under the round-2 shape) is accepted and is NOT a gate. The plan MUST state this explicitly so no executor or reviewer re-flags it.

R-C5 (resolves the improvisation risk named in the same finding; binding fences):
- LensId derivation stays exactly: export type LensId = keyof typeof LENSES at src/lenses/prompts/index.ts:146. Hand-writing the lens-id union anywhere is FORBIDDEN.
- src/lenses/prompts/index.ts receives ZERO edits in T-033. src/lenses/registry.ts receives ONLY the two visibility flips named in R-C1. src/merger/* receives ZERO edits. Those modules belong to T-026/T-027/T-028/T-030.
- No verification gate may be skipped, weakened, or reported passed without running its exact command. ANY failing gate of any kind (not only anchor drift): STOP, park the ticket, and record the failing command plus its verbatim output in the parking note. No improvised fixes outside the ruled designs above.

ESCALATIONS TO OWNER (product calls not derivable from repo facts; conservative rulings applied above):
1. R-C1 removes optsSchema from the public surface entirely. If workspace ISS-823 consumption needs direct lens-opts validation, a follow-up ticket for a parseLensOpts(lensId, opts) accessor is required; T-033 must not be widened.
2. Pre-existing 0.2.0 root exports include runtime-mutable singletons (DEFAULT_ALWAYS_BLOCK at src/schema/merger-config.ts:22 is compile-time readonly but not frozen; every re-exported Zod schema instance is monkey-patchable). Deliberately NOT hardened in T-033 because freezing shipped API is a behavior change; owner may want a 0.4.0 hardening ticket.
title: Export the lens core (registry, prompts, merger, activation) as stable library API and prep 0.3.0 for the storybloq Option A consumption
